def balanced(s):
    """Return True when every (), [] and {} in s is balanced and matched.

    Text inside double-quoted strings is ignored. Within a quoted string a

            stack.append(c)

            if not stack or stack[-1] != _PAIR[c]:
                return False
            stack.pop()
        i += 1
    return not in_string and not stack
